item.description:
IPTVMac 0.25.67 for Apple Silicon Macs running macOS 14 or later.
- Reopen the main window from the Dock after closing it with the red button. - Browse and edit playlists in Manage Playlists, with provider expiry dates, channel counts, and connection limits where available. - Set Live TV, Movies, and Series visibility for each profile. Refresh playlists and TV guides on separate schedules. - Add Xtream Codes and M3U playlists, including connection details pasted from provider messages. - Switch playlists and live previews more responsively in large libraries.
This build uses Apple Development signing and is unnotarized. macOS may block first launch. The ZIP and update feed are signed for Sparkle.
